games.name: Dying2Parkour DEMO
games.desc:
Welcome to Dying2Parkour; an open-world parkour game where you evolve your movement skills to conquer the ever-expanding world! Master your parkour skills, discover hidden routes, and push your limits as you progress through a environment built for exploration and freedom.

Currently in its demo stage, Dying2Parkour offers a glimpse into what’s to come. Future updates will introduce new features such as skill trees, minigames, party systems, time trials, gears, and more, all designed to enhance the gameplay and make the game seem more alive.

Inspired by the Dying Light franchise, Dying2Parkour reimagines its core parkour mechanics into a new and standalone experience with its own style and identity.
